verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a first-party MCP server at mcp.secureframe.com. It exposes controls, tests, vendors, frameworks, risks and more as MCP tools for querying and updating compliance data, and any MCP-capable client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor) can connect. Authentication is by OAuth sign-in, or by an API key for headless setups, and a probe confirms an official GitHub repository. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working in practice, and a detailed per-tool reference (the headless API-key path is only partly documented).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Secureframe MCP server allows you to access and manage your Secureframe data — controls, tests, vendors, frameworks, risks, and more — as Model Context Protocol tools.
Any MCP-capable client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, and others) can connect, letting you ask an assistant to look things up and take actions on your behalf.
Connect an AI assistant to your Secureframe workspace and query or update your compliance data through the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
